description: This file is a shell script used for testing git add -u functionality within a git repository. It sets up a repository, runs various tests on 'git add -u' command under different scenarios, and verifies the expected behavior through assertions and checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks for specified conditions.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or output streams for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output stream.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock to simulate time passing in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
